segments.name: Integrated circuits
segments.description: Designs, develops and sells integrated circuits and related semiconductor solutions for data center and communications and other end markets.
segments.evidence: We have determined that we operate in one reportable segment: the design, development and sale of integrated circuits.

revenueModel.text: Original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers and distributors pay for semiconductor products and custom solutions built into their end market devices.
revenueModel.evidence: Our target customers are original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and original design manufacturers, both of which design and manufacture end market devices, and distributors for these products.

changes.text: In 2025 the company completed the sale of its automotive ethernet business to Infineon Technologies AG.
changes.evidence: On August 14, 2025, we completed the sale of our automotive ethernet business to Infineon Technologies AG for $2.5 billion in cash.
